earlier_attempts: Baseline six-case regression: own-cache control passes; three foreign session/share/generation lookups return the cached listing and two tree-close cases leave their entries live. Five failures preserved.
Initial focused passes51, expanded focused passes56; first full source passes1016/110 suites before final owner-liveness additions.
Separate red tests reproduce a closed manager recreating state through an open tree and a channel-less session recreating keys while another session keeps the manager alive.

Initial native four-case acceptance uses three cached views and the same user in two sessions. Later acceptance adds a second Unix user and cached private-directory denial. Final native scopes use the current hashed source; initial discovery source is not claimed as the final candidate.
Production baseline snapshots were verified/reconstructed from commit115cdd2; failure test source preserves the original unscoped fixture. See before/source-provenance.txt.
limits: Native scope uses Samba4.23.10, NTLM, Direct TCP, BC/JCE, signing-only or optional sessionGCM, Java21 and actualJava8. Same-path distinct tree-generation tests and failed-disconnect/publication races are local; native sessions/shares use actual independently assigned tree IDs.

Private-directory denial is a real server STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED for a distinct authenticated Unix user while another user has the listing cached. It does not establish the full authorization/authentication-expiry matrix.

Existing native break variants remain unsigned plaintext SID0/MID-1 with authenticated ACKs. Native signed/random-MID/encrypted unsolicited, Async/Kerberos leasing, grant/break/cache-handle publication, DFS rerouting, recovery and queue-pressure matrices remain incomplete.
Remaining sustained costs and authentication failure/expiry/cancellation/policy variants stay tracked. Global mandatory encryption is unqualified; Windows deferred and ONTAP untested.
